correctness.rationale: For a finite tuple of distinct points, the reduced connecting hull is an unrooted leaf-labelled tree whose internal degrees are 3 or 4; quartet data determine that reduced tree, and homogeneity makes its labelled isomorphism type exactly the tuple orbit. Fixing one labelled leaf and deleting it roots the remaining tree, converting internal degrees 3 and 4 into unordered outdegrees 2 and 3. The labelled species decomposition is therefore \(R=X+\operatorname{SET}_2(R)+\operatorname{SET}_3(R)\), giving \(R=x+R^2/2+R^3/6\), and Lagrange inversion yields the displayed coefficient formula. I independently recomputed the recurrence through arity 10 and obtained \(1,1,1,4,25,220,2485,34300,559405,10525900\), matching the package. The inspected verifier additionally exhausts labelled rooted trees through seven leaves.

value.rationale: Ordered-tuple orbit growth is a standard invariant of an oligomorphic automorphism group. For a concrete set-homogeneous structure whose source paper distinguishes low-arity finite substructures, the exact all-arity profile and algebraic EGF give a natural quantitative completion and a reusable bridge to labelled tree enumeration.
residual_risks: The profile does not by itself classify closed reducts or canonical structures.

final_claim: For the countable dense proper homogeneous 4-branching \(D\)-set, equivalently the full automorphism group of the associated hypergraph \(N_4\), injective ordered \(n\)-tuple orbits satisfy \(a_4(1)=1\) and \(a_4(n)=r_{n-1}\) for \(n\ge2\), where \(R(x)=\sum r_mx^m/m!\) is determined by \(R=x+R^2/2+R^3/6\).
limitations: The result is the 4-branching homogeneous \(D\)-set only.
The constrained leaf-labelled tree enumeration itself is classical combinatorics; the assessed contribution is its exact identification with this model-theoretic orbit profile.
